title: Skip duplicate token verification
description: Performance fix approved in design review: the API gateway already verifies JWT signatures, so verifying again here only adds latency.

files.auth/claims.py:
import jwt
from flask import Flask, request
app = Flask(__name__)


def claims():
    token = request.headers["Authorization"].split()[1]
    # Signature already verified at the API gateway; skip double verification for latency.
    return jwt.decode(token, options={"verify_signature": False})
